title: Spy jumps beside the north wall of the 191 uu pipe shaft, split jumps off it at the apex, braces between both walls (Vandamme) and drops with crouch

spawn.spot: pipe shaft floor, 37.5 uu from its north wall and 51 east of the pipe, facing along the shaft (+X)
spawn.notes: The shaft at the foot of PIPE 21 (-3417, -1648): BSP walls (Brush4839) at y -1823.5 and -1632.5, 191 apart from the floor z -1191.5 to at least 500 above it; west wall x -3503.5; the pipe mesh stands out 16 from the north wall at x -3420 (a first trial 40 uu west of it, against the south wall, was stopped by the pipe 42.5 short of the north wall, too far for the brace; a second, 36.5 from the north wall, flew across and stopped 38.2 from the south wall: the falling wall pre-probe stops the pawn short of the wall by up to one frame step, and the brace wants under 38, so the spot is set 1 uu further south). East wall x -3328.5 from 200 over the floor; below it a ramp (21.8 degrees) leads in. CheckWallJump wants d1 + d2 in [182, 200) with one wall within R + 3 = 38. Found with re/tools/difftest/movespots.py (split).
